patch:
diff --git a/spec/scripts/spec-build-driver.js b/spec/scripts/spec-build-driver.js
index f8ed328..eea4ef6 100755
--- a/spec/scripts/spec-build-driver.js
+++ b/spec/scripts/spec-build-driver.js
@@ -406,7 +406,10 @@ function resolvePostGate() {
   const raw = hostConfig.postGateCommand
   if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.length === 0) return null
   const testCommand = typeof hostConfig.testCommand === 'string' ? hostConfig.testCommand : ''
-  return raw.split('{testCommand}').join(testCommand)
+  const resolvedPost = raw.split('{testCommand}').join(testCommand)
+  // A value that is all placeholder on a host declaring no testCommand resolves to nothing to
+  // run — treat that as no post-gate rather than chaining an empty command onto the gate.
+  return resolvedPost.trim().length === 0 ? null : resolvedPost
 }
 
 // ---- gate (GATE, driver-only) ---------------------------------------------------------------------

survivors.claim: resolvePostGate() returns null when the substituted post-gate is whitespace-empty, so a host declaring a non-empty postGateCommand of {testCommand} with no testCommand silently runs no post-gate, lands COMMIT, and writes gate.postGate false — the spec Behavior paragraph mandates the opposite (substituted with the empty string, the chain then fails at bash with exit 127 or 2, no special handling) and D4 mandates postGate true whenever the config declared a non-empty postGateCommand. No deviations record exists for this departure.
survivors.impact: A host whose config is missing its required test command gets a green build and a ledger row saying no post-gate was declared, instead of the loud shell failure the spec promised that points the session at the repair command.
survivors.evidence: Executed repro via the real driver against a tests/build fixture host (makeHost, toIntegration, config edited to delete testCommand and set postGateCommand to {testCommand}, then --mark integrated): status 0, state COMMIT, gateRuns [{exit:0}], marker in log false. Violating hunk at driver lines 412-413 feeds both the chain and the postGate ledger field.

survivors.claim: A commit inside the range is foreign to the spec: it only bumps reviewed: dates in three agent-memory files, none of which is a File Plan row.
survivors.impact: Unrelated housekeeping rides the spec merge under a commit subject that says nothing; harmless to behavior but muddies the range provenance.
survivors.evidence: git show --stat: 3 files under .claude/agent-memory/, 3 insertions, 3 deletions, each reviewed date bumped. reconcile leg outOfPlan 0.
